stage: initial implementation, before real model inference

old_failure_details.C05: First source action omitted columns and primary_key. After correction the model declared both source metrics scalar; percentage_point_diff then returned UNIT_MISMATCH. Repeating the same derived action consumed the remaining error budget.
old_failure_details.C09: First metric action omitted expected_count. After correction locations supplied two candidate IDs and only one name; repeating that selection error exhausted the budget.

general_product_changes: Shared declared identity and computed evidence review for staged, direct and batch proposals, CLI and Studio; numeric equality is not proof of experimental identity.
Current-stage guidance covers source-field units, typed selectors, complete count/seeds, original display precision, JSON pointers and native table identity.
At most four explicit undo actions within the existing 16-action budget; original observed hashes remain guarded and invalid actions retain the last valid draft.
No automatic acceptance, task-specific gold, scorer feedback or manuscript execution.

machine_failures_preserved.cause: A literal brace pair in localized guidance was interpreted as a format field.
machine_failures_preserved.correction: Describe empty arguments in words; staged rerun passed 5 tests.

machine_failures_preserved.cause: Switching languages retained the prior author confirmation when the proposal ID stayed the same.
machine_failures_preserved.correction: Clear confirmation at the start of language switching while retaining selected bindings.

machine_failures_preserved.cause: Importing a stale proposal hid the prior preview but left its hidden acceptance button enabled.
machine_failures_preserved.correction: Update acceptance state when no preview is present, and clear confirmation before every import attempt.

control_scope: 13 development reference/adversarial controls, zero model calls; these do not measure model success.

development_round_1.diagnosis: D02 omitted count and used an unsupported unit; D03 re-added existing declarations; D04 supplied table columns for JSON repeatedly; D05-D07 put computed mean into a statistics contract; D10 ignored missing checkpoint; D11 invented fraction units despite explicit unknown; D12 tried to derive a p-value from counts without observations.
development_round_1.response: Provide actual typed statistical schemas and clearer general field/stage guidance; display original notes as plain text; remove obsolete initial-session state from follow-up requests; retain the latest cumulative state and one previous action. No task/oracle/scoring/budget/model change.
development_round_1.concurrent_workload: The complete development pytest suite also ran on this host. Inference timings are observed call costs, not isolated performance benchmarks.
development_round_1.scope: The first implementation, prompts, raw outputs and scores remain separately preserved. No held-out inference has run.
